signatures.title: Fatal runtime failure
signatures.suggested_action: Inspect surrounding log context and create a bug or incident record.

signatures.regex: (?i)\b(sql error|mysql error|database error|unknown column|duplicate entry|access denied for user|table .* doesn't exist)\b
signatures.title: Database or SQL failure
signatures.suggested_action: Cross-check live-state SQL dumps, schema version, and import logs.

signatures.title: Authentication or realm signal
signatures.suggested_action: Verify authserver state, realmlist address, and account database state.

signatures.regex: (?i)\b(file not found|cannot find|missing file|no such file|path does not exist)\b
signatures.title: Missing file or path
signatures.suggested_action: Check path ownership, restore source, and expected module layout.

signatures.title: Docker or container signal
signatures.suggested_action: Run the live server probe and verify container availability.

signatures.title: Playerbots runtime signal
signatures.suggested_action: Check mod-playerbots config, worldserver logs, and module revision.
